lines.speaker: Long
lines.text: Hi Ha, thanks for making time to meet with us yesterday.

lines.speaker: Ha
lines.text: Of course, it was great to learn more about your platform.

lines.speaker: Long
lines.text: I wanted to circle back on the proposal we discussed.

lines.speaker: Ha
lines.text: Yes, my team is still reviewing the pricing details.

lines.speaker: Long
lines.text: No problem. As discussed, I'm sending the updated quotation today.

lines.speaker: Ha
lines.text: Great, please put the delivery timeline in writing as well.

lines.speaker: Long
lines.text: Sure, I'll loop in our project manager for the technical details.

lines.speaker: Ha
lines.text: That would help. Can you keep me posted on the next steps?

lines.speaker: Long
lines.text: Absolutely, I'll reach out again by Friday with an update.

lines.speaker: Ha
lines.text: Sounds good. I'll drop you a line if anything changes on our end.

lines.speaker: Long
lines.text: Perfect. Just a gentle reminder to check your inbox for the email.
